messages.content: Show me a man with a #3 dark brown hair system, body wave, exposed hairline

Generating that now. I'll create a portrait of a man with #3 Dark Brown Indian Remy hair, 20mm body wave, 95% medium density on a 0.03mm ultra-thin skin base. The front hairline will be fully exposed with graduated density (60% at leading edge), single bleached knots, and wispy baby hairs — completely undetectable. 85mm portrait lens, studio lighting.
What does 20% grey look like on a #1B system?

Let me generate that. #1B20 — Off Black base with 20% natural grey blended throughout, slightly heavier at the temples. The grey will appear as a distinguished salt-and-pepper pattern concentrated at the temporal areas, gradually fading toward the crown. Natural distribution, never uniform.
Generate a before and after transformation for a 45-year-old man, Norwood 5

Creating the transformation comparison. Left frame: clinical before-photo showing Norwood 5 male pattern baldness with remaining biological hair at sides and back. Right frame: the SAME man (identical face, bone structure, lighting, angle) with a restored hair system. #2 Darkest Brown, slight wave (25mm), 85% medium-light density appropriate for age 45, ultra-thin skin base with fully graduated hairline. Clinical neutral lighting both frames.
Can you do a video of the hair system in motion? I want to see how it looks when the person moves

Generating a lifestyle video now. The subject will turn his head naturally while the camera circles — showing how the hair system moves with authentic hair physics. Wind passes through individual strands. The hairline remains completely invisible at every angle. #1B Off Black, 25mm slight wave, 95% density. Natural outdoor lighting. 8 seconds, 4K cinematic quality.
Show me the difference between Swiss lace and ultra-thin skin at the hairline

I'll generate two closeup comparisons. First: Swiss lace hairline — fine mesh disappearing against the scalp, maximum ventilation, completely undetectable at 5cm distance. Second: ultra-thin skin hairline — transparent 0.03mm polyurethane with visible scalp pore reflection through the base. Both have graduated 60% density, bleached knots, and baby hairs. 100mm macro lens for detail.
What would I look like with an afro curl hair system? I have Afro-textured biological hair on the sides

I'll generate that portrait. 4-8mm tight coils, Afro-textured curl pattern. Matched to blend seamlessly with your biological Afro-textured side hair. 95% medium density. Swiss lace base for maximum ventilation and undetectability. The curl pattern will be consistent from system to biological hair — no visible transition point. Natural studio lighting, 85mm portrait.
Generate an image showing why a blunt hairline is bad and a graduated hairline is good

I'll create a split comparison. Left side: a detectable hair system — visible blunt edge at the hairline, dark unbleached knots forming a dotted line, uniform full density starting instantly at the edge, no baby hairs. This is what a BAD hair system looks like. Right side: an undetectable system — graduated 60%→40% density at the front 0.5cm, single bleached knots invisible against scalp, irregular wispy baby hairs, natural scalp pore reflection. This is the Hair Solutions Co. standard.
Show a man swimming with his hair system. Does it look natural wet?

Generating a lifestyle image of a man emerging from water. His hair system is wet — hair clumps naturally, water droplets on individual strands. The hairline remains undetectable even when wet because the 0.03mm ultra-thin skin base is transparent and bonded with Ghost Bond water-resistant adhesive. The wet hair reveals natural density distribution — no solid helmet mass. French lace body for drainage. Natural outdoor pool lighting.
I want to see a side-by-side: #1 Jet Black straight vs #3 Dark Brown body wave on the same person

Creating a comparison of the same man with two different hair systems. Both images use subject consistency to preserve identical facial features. Left: #1 Jet Black, 32mm straight, sleek formal appearance, 95% density. Right: #3 Dark Brown, 20mm body wave, textured casual appearance, same density. Same lighting, same angle, same wardrobe. This shows how different specifications change the entire look while the face remains the same person.
Generate a professional corporate headshot of a man wearing a hair system. It must be completely undetectable

Generating corporate headshot. #1B Off Black, 25mm slight wave for natural movement, 90% medium-light density (age-appropriate for 35-45 professional), ultra-thin skin 0.03mm base. The hairline is deliberately slightly covered — a natural side part that sweeps across. Even though the hairline isn't fully exposed, the base edge at the side transition is invisible. Studio lighting with soft key, navy suit, professional expression. 85mm f/1.4. Zero detectable signs of a hair system.
